interface.description: Network interface to listen on for ARP requests.

target_ip.description: IPv4 address the daemon will claim via ARP.

target_mac.description: MAC address the daemon will associate with the target IP.

debug.description: Enable verbose logging to syslog (set to true for detailed diagnostics).

max_pending.description: Maximum number of concurrent pending ARP requests (0 = unlimited).

log_prefix.description: Prefix used in syslog messages to distinguish farpd logs.

items.description: Allowed source IP range (CIDR notation) for incoming ARP requests.

allowed_sources.description: List of allowed source networks (CIDR). Requests outside these ranges are ignored.

gratuitous_arp.description: Send gratuitous ARP on startup to announce the virtual IP.

gratuitous_delay.description: Delay (milliseconds) before sending gratuitous ARP after interface up.

arp_timeout.description: Time (seconds) after which cached ARP entries are considered stale and purged.

post_reply_hook.description: Optional shell command to execute after each ARP reply is sent. Receives interface, source IP, and target IP as arguments.
